title: Slack notifications missing for mentions in threads

changes.text: New comment from Priya Nair on the Jira issue describing repro steps.

sources.author: Priya Nair
sources.summary: Repro steps: mention a user in a thread reply, no notification is sent even though it works for top-level messages.

sources.author: #notify-service-eng
sources.summary: Thread: engineers suspect the thread-reply fan-out path skips the mention parser that the top-level path uses.

sources.author: Marcus Webb
sources.summary: Draft MR: route thread replies through the same mention parser as top-level messages.
